description: This file defines a SwiftUI view component for Tailscale integration section in a macOS application, including configuration, status monitoring, and user interface elements to manage Tailscale modes and credentials.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSection
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that manages and displays Tailscale network settings, status, and authentication options within the app.

classes.name: GatewayTailscaleMode
classes.description: An enumeration representing different Tailscale operational modes: off, serve, and funnel.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Asynchronously loads configuration data for Tailscale mode, credentials, and related settings from persistent storage.

methods.name: applySettings
methods.description: Validates user input and saves the updated Tailscale configuration, prompting a gateway restart if necessary.

methods.name: buildAndSaveTailscaleConfig
methods.description: Builds a configuration dictionary based on current settings and saves it to persistent storage.

methods.name: restartGatewayIfNeeded
methods.description: Triggers a gateway restart if the Tailscale mode has been changed and the current state warrants it.

methods.name: startStatusTimer
methods.description: Sets up periodic status checking of the Tailscale service.

methods.name: stopStatusTimer
methods.description: Stops the periodic status timer for Tailscale status updates.
